info.name: AlayaCare Accounting Accounts Form Submissions API

params.name: create_user_id
params.description: Filter by create user ID

params.name: external_employee_id
params.description: Filter by external employee ID

params.name: account_id
params.description: Filter by AlayaCare client or facility ID

params.name: external_client_id
params.description: Filter by external client ID

params.name: submitted_from
params.description: Filter by creation date greater or equal than specified value. If not specified, the default date will be today.

params.name: submitted_to
params.description: Filter by creation date less or equal than specified value. If not specified, the default date will be 2 weeks from the start date

params.name: form_id
params.description: Filter by form ID

params.name: schema_id
params.description: Filter by the `schema_id` to get submissions of all versions of the same form

params.name: with_fields
params.description: Include the submission fields in the response. By default fields are not included

params.name: work_session_id
params.description: Filter by work session ID

params.name: client_group_id[]
params.description: Filter by client's group ID

params.name: client_group_id_mode
params.description:
The logical mode to use for client_group_id.
'all' results in a logical 'and'
'any' results in a logical 'or'

params.name: visit_id
params.description: Filter by visit ID

params.name: form_type
params.description: Filter by form type

params.name: asc
params.description: Order for sorting

params.name: page
params.description: Filter by page number. If not specified will default to 1

params.name: count
params.description: Number of items per page. If not specified will default to 100

items.docs:
* Only form submissions that the current user can view will be returned.
* Results are ordered by the form submission ID in ascending order by default.
* Requires one of the following ACLs:
  - `ACL_PATROL_CLIENT_REPORTS_VIEW`
  - `ACL_CLIENT_SHIFTREPORT_VIEW`
  - `ACL_CLIENT_REPORTS_VIEW`
  - `ACL_CLIENT_REPORTS_HISTORICAL_VIEW`
* `account_id` and `external_client_id` are mutually exclusive.
* `create_user_id` and `external_employee_id` are mutually exclusive.
